verdictRule: A model beats taking every setup only if, out of fold, the trades it keeps beat the trades it skips with a Welch t of at least 2.0 (threshold chosen on earlier predictions only), the kept trades average more than all trades, and the last fold shows the same. Otherwise: rejected challenger.
promotion: manual, by the owner, through the API (model.register then model.promote). Nothing here promotes a model.
